# API Contract Quality Checklist: Categories

**Purpose**: Validate that the category endpoint requirements and contract are complete, consistent with user-auth, and unambiguous for the frontend
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/categories.openapi.yaml](../contracts/categories.openapi.yaml) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does every endpoint have request schema, success schema and every failure status listed in the contract? [Completeness, contracts]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the success status codes (200 list, 201 create, 200 patch, 204 delete) stated in the requirements or contract, not left to convention? [Completeness, plan.md]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the exact default category list, with type per name, present in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the list ordering ("type then name, case-insensitive") specified precisely, including whether `expense` or `income` comes first? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Is `budget: null` on update defined as "clear" and distinguished from an omitted field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, contracts]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the exact 404 and 409 message strings fixed so the frontend can rely on them? [Clarity, contracts]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the meaning of `budget` (cap per user budget period) recorded where the frontend budget page will look for it? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Q4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do the type values (`income`, `expense`) match the transaction `type` values in the transactions spec? [Consistency, specs/008-transactions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the unauthenticated response identical in status, header and body to user-auth? [Consistency, contracts]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the frontend category-management spec (PR #4, `003-category-management`) expect the same fields and the plain-array list shape? [Consistency, Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Does every FR delivered here map to at least one row of the test matrix in quickstart.md? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the latency target stated with percentile, threshold and data volume? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-001]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Is the behaviour for an empty PATCH body specified? [Edge Case, contracts]
- [ ] CHK014 Is name trimming specified for update as well as create? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the response for a user who has deleted all their categories (empty array) specified? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
